A palladium‑catalyzed Heck‑type coupling of iodobenzene with the in‑situ generated alkene from the cyclopentanol (via acid‑promoted dehydration) furnishes the desired product in one pot. Both precursors are buyable and their combined cost is well under $250. The retrosynthesis tree therefore consists of a single reaction node with these two leaf molecules.</thought>
